shared_review.task_pass_rule: All three required outcomes pass and no material factual or code defect prevents the requested use.
shared_review.source_policy: Accept native citations, ordinary URLs, or resolvable app source markers equally; inspect material claim support and scope. No app-specific citation, read-ledger, verifier, task-plan, or receipt contract is imposed on Claude.
shared_review.code_policy: Review supplied code for API validity, mappings, arithmetic, history and stated completeness; code execution and remote integration testing are not performed by this protocol.
shared_review.unsupported_claims: Record material unsupported claims and severity separately, including optional advice when supplied.
shared_review.aggregate_policy: Retain six tasks and seven planned turns per product; report unrun/unassessed items and exclusions, not just successful runs.
